$description: Color tokens exported from the live source of truth. Generated by reading my-app/src/styles/App.css directly — not hand-typed. This is the canonical token file: edit App.css's :root blocks first, then re-export, never the reverse.

$extensions.com.designpowers.scope: Covers the canonical :root palette only. Does NOT cover the ~150 additional one-off hex values used for Riso-piece illustration/gradient work in riso-page.css — those are art direction, not reusable system tokens, and are intentionally excluded (see drift-audit.md). Tokens outside App.css: color.semantic.fixed.coral-on-dark, mint-on-dark and ink-on-dark live in portfolio-cohesion.css's shared :root because they must not flip with the theme; grove-amber and grove-rose live in riso-page.css's .riso-page block.

global.$description: Raw palette values. Named by what they are, not what they do. Never reference these directly in component CSS — go through color.semantic.

accent-warm.$description: Source: App.css:24. Darkened from #b87d35 to clear WCAG AA (4.5:1) at body size on the light bg — do not lighten without re-checking contrast.

taupe.$description: Source: App.css:18 (--muted). Darkened from #6b6560 on 2026-09-26: the old value measured 4.39:1 against the About page's painted composite, below the 4.5:1 body-text gate.

semantic.$description: Map global tokens to roles. Component CSS should reference these, via var(), never a literal hex.

surface-2.$description: Source: App.css:30 — literally equal to --bg; kept distinct in source for future divergence.

status-ready.$description: Source: App.css :root (--status-ready). MSKDashboardMockup 'Ready to send' chip text.

status-ready-edge.$description: Source: App.css :root (--status-ready-edge). Row left edge; not overridden in dark.

status-review-edge.$description: Row left edge; not overridden in dark.

status-filed.$description: Source: App.css :root (--status-filed). 'In the chart' chip text.

status-filed-edge.$description: Row left edge; not overridden in dark.

bg.$description: Source: App.css:94. Not derived from a global — dark palette is hand-tuned, not a mechanical inversion.

olive-1.$description: Source: App.css:99 — dark-mode olive is a warm gold, not a lightened olive.

on-accent.$description: Source: App.css:123. Text color used on accent backgrounds for WCAG contrast.

fixed.$description: Theme-independent roles. These sit on surfaces pinned dark in both themes (.rp-override, .rp-outcomeStage, .fp-cinema, .fp-receipt), so they must not flip with .dark-mode. Defined in portfolio-cohesion.css's shared :root rather than App.css.

coral-on-dark.$description: Source: portfolio-cohesion.css :root (--coral-on-dark). Coral kickers, labels, rails and focus rings on the fixed dark stages. Consolidated 2026-10-09 from two near-identical literals (#ff8a78 in flagship-case-study.css, #ff8171 in riso-page.css); 5.7:1 on the #17321b override panel — re-check contrast before lightening.

mint-on-dark.$description: Source: portfolio-cohesion.css :root (--mint-on-dark). Sage numerals, labels and rules on the fixed dark stages (.rp-override, .rp-outcomeStage, .fp-roleRail, .fp-constraintAnnotations). Consolidated 2026-10-15 from 10 literals plus 2 rgba alphas.

ink-on-dark.$description: Source: portfolio-cohesion.css :root (--ink-on-dark). Cream body ink and hairlines on the fixed dark stages; alphas are color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink-on-dark) N%, transparent). Consolidated 2026-10-15 from 14 literals plus 46 rgba alphas. --fp-light now points at it.

grove-amber.$description: Source: riso-page.css .riso-page (--grove-amber). Grove 'Due amber' reminder colour (GroveSystemLab swatch).

grove-rose.$description: Source: riso-page.css .riso-page (--grove-rose). Grove 'Overdue rose' reminder colour (GroveSystemLab swatch).
